title: Winston-Salem, NC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Winston-Salem is a city in NC with a population of 249,545. Twin City with tobacco history, Wake Forest, and affordable Piedmont living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
